recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, studio-lit portrait of a man in formal evening wear set against a solid, light cyan-blue background. The composition features high-contrast, bold slab-serif typography stacked vertically in the upper right quadrant, utilizing a vibrant magenta and deep purple color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally but weighted towards the bottom half
Text block aligned to the right, balancing the subject's head
High contrast between the dark tuxedo and the bright, flat background
Color harmony between the magenta text and the red pocket square accent
coreInvariants: Direct eye contact from the subject
Formal black tuxedo with a bow tie

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, head and shoulders, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the dark mass of the tuxedo.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, moves up to the bold display text on the right, then down through the smaller metadata text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample open space in the upper left and surrounding the head to allow the background color to breathe.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta and Red (Typography and Pocket Square)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation background vs. low-value, high-contrast subject and high-saturation accents.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cyan, magenta, black, and white

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with vertical stress
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for impact paired with a functional condensed sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif and sharp corners of the display type.
Provides the necessary weight and geometric slab feel.
Appropriate for the secondary metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in his 30s with 1960s styling, wearing a black tuxedo and bow tie, centered against a flat, solid light cyan background. Ensure lighting is soft but directional, creating a clean, professional look.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned text in the upper right quadrant. Use a heavy slab-serif font in magenta for the main title, stacked vertically. Below it, add secondary information in a smaller, condensed sans-serif font in deep blue.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, flat cyan?
Is the main text a bold slab serif?
Does the subject wear a tuxedo?

adjustableVariables: Typography color (magenta vs. other high-contrast hues)
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is cut off by the frame edges.
Check that the magenta color pops against the cyan background.
Verify the subject's pose is formal and centered.
Confirm the slab-serif font weight is sufficiently heavy.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Solid Pastel Background + Right-Aligned Slab Serif Typography Stack.
